newsitem.title: UK: Oldest Titanic survivor dies aged 100. [CORRECTED 21:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Oldest Titanic survivor dies aged 100. [CORRECTED 21:40 GMT]

text.p: Edith Haisman, the oldest survivor of the 1912 sinking of the liner Titanic, has died at the age of 100 in a British retirement home, her family said on Tuesday.
Haisman's daughter Dorothy told London's Evening Standard newspaper that her mother had been suffering from a chest infection. She died on Monday.
"I will remember it forever, the darkness and the cold," Haisman once said of the night she and her mother were lowered in a lifeboat from the liner after it struck an iceberg in the north Atlantic.

She remembered her father standing on the deck of the Titanic, smoking a cigar, sipping a glass of brandy and telling her: "I'll see you in New York." He was among 1,500 people who went down with the ship.
